profile.name: Maria Lopez
profile.goal: Help the next generation of women lawyers get their start

steps.text: Offer a 20-minute call to a student on your path
steps.why: One conversation can change a student's first year.

steps.text: Nominate a junior colleague for a speaking slot
steps.why: Sponsorship moves careers faster than advice.
